reason: I am not going to pay R699 a month to a company with no restaurants live yet, and I have no reason to believe it will work on a Friday night when the power drops. My older regulars would rather be waited on than scan a code, so I would be paying to make some of my tables worse.
objection: Nobody has proven this in a real restaurant yet, and I would be the test case while my staff still ring everything up on the POS anyway. That is double the work at the busiest time.
would_change_my_mind: A free pilot in my own restaurant, running through a load-shedding evening, with proof that the tablets keep working and that my older customers still get a waiter if they ask for one.
